```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)

# Keep complete observations
d <- listings |>
  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(list_price),
    list_price > 0
  )

# Convert coordinates to a projected CRS in metres
pts <- st_as_sf(
  d,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326
) |>
  st_transform(26917)

coords <- st_coordinates(pts)

# Define each listing's 8 nearest neighbours
knn <- knearneigh(coords, k = 8)
nb <- knn2nb(knn)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

# Test for spatial autocorrelation in prices
moran.mc(
  log(d$list_price),
  lw,
  nsim = 999
)
```
there is spatial autocorrelation!

```{r}
plot(listings$longitude, listings$list_price)
```

```{r}
x <- log(d$list_price)

# Local Moran's I
local_moran <- localmoran(
  x,
  lw,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Add results to the data
d_lisa <- d |>
  mutate(
    local_I = local_moran[, "Ii"],
    local_EI = local_moran[, "E.Ii"],
    local_p = local_moran[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"],
    price_z = as.numeric(scale(x)),
    lag_price_z = lag.listw(lw, price_z, zero.policy = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cluster = case_when(
      local_p < 0.05 & price_z > 0 & lag_price_z > 0 ~ "High-High",
      local_p < 0.05 & price_z < 0 & lag_price_z < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
      local_p < 0.05 & price_z > 0 & lag_price_z < 0 ~ "High-Low",
      local_p < 0.05 & price_z < 0 & lag_price_z > 0 ~ "Low-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(d_lisa, aes(longitude, latitude, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "High-High" = "#D7191C",
    "Low-Low" = "#2C7BB6",
    "High-Low" = "#FDAE61",
    "Low-High" = "#ABD9E9",
    "Not significant" = "#D9D9D9"
  )) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Local Moran's I: Listing Price Clusters",
    subtitle = "Eight nearest neighbours; BH-adjusted p < 0.05",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    colour = "Cluster"
  )
```

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

# Plot basemap
plotRGB(basemap)

# Transform points to basemap CRS
pts_map <- st_transform(pts, crs(basemap))

# Colour points by log price
price_colours <- viridis(100)
price_values <- log(d_lisa$list_price)

# Map prices to colour indices
colour_index <- cut(
  price_values,
  breaks = 100,
  labels = FALSE
)

plot(
  vect(pts_map),
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 16,
  col = price_colours[colour_index],
  cex = 0.7
)

# Add a legend for log price
legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = round(
    quantile(price_values, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
    2
  ),
  col = price_colours[seq(1, 100, length.out = 6) |> round()],
  pch = 16,
  title = "Log price",
  bty = "n"
)
```


there is evidence of a yearly trend in listing prices, but no statistically significant evidence of monthly seasonality

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Fit a simple linear time trend
model_trend <- lm(mean_log_price ~ year, data = monthly)

# Add fitted values
monthly <- monthly |>
  mutate(
    fitted = predict(model_trend),
    residual = residuals(model_trend)
  )

# Plot observed prices and fitted trend
ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_log_price), colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted), colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean Log Listing Price",
    subtitle = "Blue = observed prices; red = linear yearly trend",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Mean log listing price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = residual)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Residuals After Removing the Yearly Trend",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Residual log price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
residual_ts <- ts(monthly$residual, frequency = 12)

acf(
  residual_ts,
  lag.max = 36,
  main = "ACF of Residuals"
)
```

```{r}
Box.test(
  monthly$residual,
  lag = 12,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)
```
there is still autocorrelation


```{r}
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)

model_gam <- gam(
  mean_log_price ~ s(as.numeric(month), k = 12),
  data = monthly,
  method = "REML"
)

monthly$fitted_gam <- predict(model_gam)
monthly$residual_gam <- residuals(model_gam)

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_log_price), colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_gam), colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Log Prices with a Smooth Trend",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Mean log listing price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
acf(
  monthly$residual_gam,
  lag.max = 36,
  main = "ACF of GAM Residuals"
)

Box.test(
  monthly$residual_gam,
  lag = 12,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)
```

Monthly mean log listing prices exhibit a nonlinear temporal trend. A linear trend leaves significant residual autocorrelation, whereas a GAM with a smooth time effect substantially reduces it. We found no statistically significant evidence of month-of-year seasonality, although the synthetic nature of the dataset limits real-world interpretation.



```{r}
library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

monthly <- monthly |>
  arrange(month) |>
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(month - min(month)) / 30.4375,
    month_num = month(month)
  )

# Model 1: smooth long-term trend only
model_trend <- gam(
  mean_log_price ~ s(time, k = 12),
  data = monthly,
  method = "REML"
)

# Model 2: smooth trend + annual seasonality
model_seasonal <- gam(
  mean_log_price ~
    s(time, k = 12) +
    s(month_num, bs = "cc", k = 12),
  data = monthly,
  method = "REML",
  knots = list(month_num = c(0.5, 12.5))
)

summary(model_trend)
summary(model_seasonal)
```

```{r}
monthly <- monthly |>
  mutate(
    fitted_trend = predict(model_trend),
    fitted_seasonal = predict(model_seasonal)
  )

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_log_price, colour = "Observed")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_trend, colour = "Trend only"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_seasonal, colour = "Trend + seasonality"),
            linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Observed" = "grey40",
    "Trend only" = "steelblue",
    "Trend + seasonality" = "firebrick"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparing Trend and Seasonal GAMs",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Mean log listing price",
    colour = "Series"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
rolling_cv <- function(data, initial = 36, horizon = 6) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  results <- list()
  j <- 1

  for (end_train in seq(initial, n - horizon, by = 6)) {
    train <- data[1:end_train, ]
    test  <- data[(end_train + 1):(end_train + horizon), ]

    fit_trend <- gam(
      mean_log_price ~ s(time, k = 12),
      data = train,
      method = "REML"
    )

    fit_seasonal <- gam(
      mean_log_price ~
        s(time, k = 12) +
        s(month_num, bs = "cc", k = 12),
      data = train,
      method = "REML",
      knots = list(month_num = c(0.5, 12.5))
    )

    results[[j]] <- data.frame(
      month = test$month,
      actual = test$mean_log_price,
      trend = predict(fit_trend, newdata = test),
      seasonal = predict(fit_seasonal, newdata = test)
    )

    j <- j + 1
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

cv <- rolling_cv(monthly)

cv |>
  summarise(
    trend_RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - trend)^2)),
    seasonal_RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - seasonal)^2)),
    trend_MAE = mean(abs(actual - trend)),
    seasonal_MAE = mean(abs(actual - seasonal))
  )
```

```{r}
plot(
  model_seasonal,
  select = 2,
  shade = TRUE,
  main = "Estimated Annual Seasonal Effect",
  xlab = "Month",
  ylab = "Effect on mean log price"
)
```

```{r}
summary(model_seasonal)
```

```{r}
library(mgcv)

d_model <- listings |>
  mutate(
    date_listed = as.Date(date_listed),
    log_price = log(list_price),
    house_area = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", house_area)),
    time = as.numeric(date_listed - min(date_listed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    month_num = month(date_listed),
    house_type_name = factor(house_type_name),
    house_style = factor(house_style),
    municipality = factor(municipality),
    community = factor(community)
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(log_price),
    !is.na(date_listed),
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude)
  )
```

```{r}
d_sf <- st_as_sf(
  d_model,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

d_sf <- st_transform(d_sf, 26917)

coords <- st_coordinates(d_sf)
d_model$x <- coords[, 1]
d_model$y <- coords[, 2]
```


```{r}
m_spatiotemporal <- bam(
  log_price ~
    house_type_name +
    house_style +
    bedrooms +
    washrooms +
    parking_total +
    municipality +
    community +
    garage +
    house_area +
    lot_front +
    lot_depth +
    s(x, y, k = 100) +
    s(time, k = 20) +
    s(month_num, bs = "cc", k = 12),
  data = d_model,
  method = "REML",
  knots = list(month_num = c(0.5, 12.5)),
  na.action = na.exclude
)

summary(m_spatiotemporal)
```
